scheme_name: Karmaveer Padmashri Dadasaheb Gaikwad Birth Centenary And Prize Distribution
other_conditions: Applicant must have performed social movement work
Applicant must be from a Social Welfare Sector or Institute and be registered
Applicant must have at least 15 years of social service experience
Male applicants must be at least 50 years old
Female applicants must be at least 40 years old
Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must be a permanent resident of Maharashtra
benefits_summary: Recipient receives ₹51,000 along with memorabilia, shawl and coconut.
